senses.gloss: m. (צוּר; cmp. זוּרְיוֹן, זַיָּירָא) juice, brine. Sifra Sh’mini, ch. IV, Par. 3 (ref. to Lev. XI, 12) שקץ לאסור את צִירָן ורוטבן וכ׳ ‘abomination’ is used to imply the prohibition of their brine or soup &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:6">Ab. Zar. II, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 35b:10">35ᵇ</cite>) <he>צ׳ שאין בה דגה</he> (read <cite ref="B00198"><he>בו</he></cite>) brine in which no fish is distinguishable. Ib. 40ᵃ <he>בצירן</he> in their brine (without the fish), opp. <he>בגופן</he>.
